title: scaffold-specification.json contract (post-materialize)
description: Structural contract for asic/<module>/Verification/simulation-plan/scaffold-specification.json, validated at the sim-plan Completion Gate AFTER the materialize-scaffold verb has run. Strongly validates LLM-authored fields; tolerates (does not deep-validate) the interface/transaction objects materialize-scaffold injects into agents[] (their content is owned by materialize-scaffold + sim/_guards._agent_io). Referential integrity (compare_txn/inports/seqs/sequence_ref resolving to declared agents/sequences) is NOT expressible here; the check-scaffold gate's semantic layer enforces it.

feature.description: The features.json id this test exercises. Required: it is the key materialize-scaffold resolves feature_name through, and the only thing that makes a result traceable.

test_id.description: Stable per-test identifier; the regression log keys results by it.

suites.description: Which suites run this test. YOUR judgment as the plan author, not a script's: `make smoke` runs the smoke set, `make regress` runs everything. A smoke test is one whose failure means the design is broken badly enough that running the rest is pointless — pick them by that, not by position in the list.

feature_name.description: Script-injected by `simplan materialize-scaffold` (never hand-authored): the matching features.json entry's `name`, verbatim. It is what the Feature column of case-results-summary.md prints, so a human reads this rather than a bare id.

inlined_check_hints.description: Script-injected by `simplan materialize-scaffold` (never hand-authored): the precise check semantics from the authored `check-hints/<child>.json`, materialized into this testpoint via its `covers[]`. `implementation_detail` is verbatim-if-present-else-summary.
